ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: module receives global clock for synchronous logic
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple processes

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.function: module receives external reset; sets reset_cause indicator

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.function: module receives debugger reset; sets reset_cause indicator

ports.name: rstn_sys_i
ports.function: module receives system reset; resets internal registers

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.function: module receives bus request (address, data, control)
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data compared to reset_pwd_c and used to write ctrl

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: module receives bus address; selects target register

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.function: module receives bus write data and watchdog password

relationship.object: wdt password and register write data

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.function: module receives byte-enable field (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.function: module receives bus strobe; indicates valid request

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.function: module receives read/write indicator for bus accesses

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.function: module receives request source ID (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.function: module receives privilege flag (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.function: module receives debug flag (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.function: module receives AMO indication (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.function: module receives AMO opcode (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.function: module receives bus lock signal (unused)

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.function: module receives fence flag (unused)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.function: module drives bus response (ack/err/data) back to bus

relationship.object: readback data including ctrl and reset_cause

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.function: module drives response acknowledge signal

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.function: module drives response error flag (always zero)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.function: module drives response data with register readback

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.function: module drives clock-generator enable output

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.function: module receives clock-generator input vector

ports.name: rstn_o
ports.function: module drives timeout reset output (active low)

signals.name: ctrl
signals.function: holds WDT control configuration (enable, lock, strict, timeout)
signals.evidence: assigned in bus_access; fields used by hw_rst_timeout and clkgen_en_o

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.function: enable or disable the watchdog timer
signals.evidence: used by hw_rst_timeout, cnt_started and clkgen_en_o assignments

signals.name: ctrl.lock
signals.function: lock writes to control register when set
signals.evidence: bus_access checks if ctrl.lock='0' to allow writes, else sets reset_force

signals.name: ctrl.strict
signals.function: force hardware reset on illegal access or bad password
signals.evidence: hw_rst_access <= ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force

signals.name: ctrl.timeout
signals.function: programmed timeout value for the watchdog counter
signals.evidence: used in cnt_timeout when (cnt = ctrl.timeout) and read via bus_rsp_o

signals.name: prsc_tick
signals.function: prescaler tick from clock generator bit
signals.evidence: assigned from clkgen_i(bit) and used to compute cnt_inc

signals.name: cnt
signals.evidence: incremented: cnt <= unsigned(cnt)+1; cleared on reset_wdt or ctrl.enable='0'

signals.name: cnt_inc
signals.function: controls when counter increments on prescaler tick
signals.evidence: cnt_inc <= prsc_tick and cnt_started; used to increment cnt

signals.name: cnt_timeout
signals.function: flags when counter equals programmed timeout
signals.evidence: cnt_timeout <= '1' when cnt_started='1' and cnt = ctrl.timeout

signals.name: reset_cause
signals.function: stores cause of the last system reset
signals.evidence: assigned from rstn_dbg_i, hw_rst_timeout, hw_rst_access; read via bus_rsp_o

signals.name: hw_rst_timeout
signals.function: asserts hardware reset due to watchdog timeout
signals.evidence: hw_rst_timeout <= ctrl.enable and cnt_timeout and prsc_tick; rstn_o <= not(hw_rst_timeout or hw_rst_access)

signals.name: hw_rst_access
signals.function: asserts hardware reset on illegal watchdog access
signals.evidence: hw_rst_access <= ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force; fed to rstn_o

signals.name: reset_wdt
signals.function: reset the watchdog counter (feed the dog)
signals.evidence: set on correct password; wdt_counter clears cnt when reset_wdt='1'

signals.name: reset_force
signals.function: indicates illegal access or incorrect password detected
signals.evidence: set in bus_access on locked-write attempt or incorrect password
